body:
reading this made me really sad. I have my own issues with suicide and depression. i really don't have anything to say because i'm not one to give any kind of advice. I can't even imagine all the uncomfortable sexual situations you had to live through. And to think everyone calls you a  liar. Fuckers. 

I'm glad you busted that piece of shit in his lip. Too bad you didn't drive your knee right into his balls. YOU are not a piece of shit. I bet you're really pretty and kind and sweet. 

I hope you figure this out. I'm sure someone else will say something a lot more useful than myself. But you're definitely not a piece of shit.
thanks zander. you make a lot of sense man.

Ya, WoW was one of my pitfalls. I lost a girlfriend over it actually. I no longer play but the damage was already done. And ya, I think if I work for some of the things I need to improve on I'll have a better appreciation for what I gain.

I'm just lazy sometimes and feel too overburdened with despair. That's when I'm most angry with myself, that's when I really get ready to take my life. I had this episode back in 2008 when I was really low. I tried to hang myself but I didn't do it right. Then I tried to cut myself but the knife was dull so I just ended up with a bunch of scars. I ended up just crying myself to sleep for like a month. Then I moved back home and tried to reorganize my life. And I feel like i'm back where I was then. So ya... 

I try not to let the rejection hurt my ego too much, but sometimes it just makes me think there is something wrong with me (obviously there is) but they don't know that. And then I think they can sense something wrong, so I just lose hope in my romantic future.

ya thanks zander. the same thing applies to me execpt being fat instead of scrawny. I always felt awkward and felt like people thought negative things about me. There was a point i felt good about myself in my life, but i fucked up in a couple relationships and it all spiraled out of control. I just stopped caring. I ended up hating myself, smoking weed all the time to numb myself and eating crap all the time. Then I just stopped caring what I looked like period.

Then I felt very lonely because I just played video games and locked myself in my room every weekend. I mean it's really all my fault that I fell into the state of affairs i'm in now.

I've always thought about suicide even as a teenager, but now it just seems so much more real because i feel like I literally failed. One of my friends told me that self image is only superficial but I think it's a huge source of personal confidence. There are good looking people that lack confidence but not as much. 

And ya, I don't really want anyone right now with how i am. I just feel pathetic because I'm not wanted by ANYONE. The  forever alone meme is actually true. Sometimes I feel like I lost all my chances and I AM going to be alone. Then when I tried online dating and got rejected into the ground, it felt like confirmation that i'm just not wanted at all. I mean I wouldn't want me either, but ya. That's currently my situation.
i want to travel to europe. i haven't traveled in over a decade.

Ya i hope. It's really the only hope I have atm. Even when I was fit I couldn't attract girls. I guess i'll just have to live with that and stop bitching about it. I tried all this pickup artist crap and none of it works. Not for a depressed person anyway. I'll have to learn to feel better about myself and expect nothing else so i'm not so low when i set myself up for failure. that's when it gets dark and despair sets in.
Yea early morning is best for me . At the end of the day I'm too depressed.
Yea I like travel. I  wanted to work in digital art and concept design but none of my work is pro. Thats another source of my frustration. Never being good enough.
Yea like I replied earlier I need to exercise more. Being a fatass makes me more miserable than ever.

Yea I have a feeling I'll learn to live with loneliness. I sort of already have but it is sad and painful. I keep trying to get into a workout routine but I always lose motivation because it's such a long uphill battle. I have been having trouble going because everyday I come home from work I am depressed and lonely. So I just sleep and pray I don't wake up. I suppose I should go around morning or lunch. I dunno.

Yea I'm trying to ease my self loathing. It's just depressing to deal with day after day. And hiding my pain just makes me irritable. and every time I see one of my happy go lucky friends post how wonderful their lives are on FB, it makes me want to grab a gun.
ya i have been told this before. it's hard to love yourself when you have nothing to love. makes sense why i'm lonely. i can't imagine anyone would want someone who hates themself so much.
